hero.question: Will Anthropic IPO by October 31, 2026?
hero.prob_take: The 55% bid is the market saying "we genuinely don't know", which matters because Anthropic's valuation (reported $15B+) and funding trajectory suggest IPO timing is as much about founder preference as market conditions, yet traders are pricing it like a coin flip with no edge.
